info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Replace Streaming Subscriptions Downgrade-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Downgrade API facilitates the process of modifying existing streaming subscriptions to a lower service tier. This operation allows service providers to efficiently manage customer subscription levels, supporting changes in user consumption needs or budget constraints. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and automated billing systems that handle subscription adjustments. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance user satisfaction and streamline subscription management processes.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to downgrade their current subscription plan to a lower tier. Ensure that the new plan meets the eligibility criteria prior to making this request.

requestBody.description: Request body for downgrading a subscription. This request specifies the details necessary to change the subscription level, including any applicable identifiers and downgrade options.
